blocks.text: Setting up Gmail for compliance coordinators on Mac

Google does not provide a native Gmail application for macOS. You must rely on a browser like Safari or Chrome. For a better experience, create a dedicated web app. In Safari, go to File > Add to Dock. This allows you to open Gmail as its own window. It keeps your compliance correspondence separate from your general web browsing.

Shortcuts are essential for managing high email volumes. Go to Settings > General > Keyboard shortcuts to enable them. Once active, press ? to see a full list. You can use c to compose, e to archive, and r to reply. These small habits save significant time during long audit cycles.

Compliance work involves constant documentation. Create labels for each project or vendor. Use filters to route incoming emails from specific domains directly into these labels. This keeps your primary inbox focused on urgent tasks. You can create a filter by clicking the search options icon in the search bar and selecting Create filter.

Lazur helps you stay in the flow. When you need to draft a complex policy update, hold the fn key and dictate your thoughts. Lazur provides clean, formatted text at your cursor. You do not need to type every word manually. This reduces the time spent on repetitive data entry.
Handling email volume and sending limits

Compliance coordinators often send mass updates to internal teams. Be aware of your daily sending limits. Personal accounts are limited to 500 recipients per day. Workspace accounts allow up to 2,000 recipients. If you exceed these, Google may block your account for 24 hours. Always check your recipient list before hitting send.

blocks.text: One common mistake is failing to use CC and BCC correctly. When sending mass policy updates, always use BCC to protect recipient privacy. Another issue is forgetting to enable OAuth for third-party tools. If you use an external client like Apple Mail, ensure it supports modern authentication. Using older methods creates security risks that audit teams will flag.
What to do when you get stuck

If you cannot find a specific setting, ask Lazur. Hold ⌥ ⌘ and ask where the filter settings are. Lazur will circle the button on your screen. This helps you learn the interface without hunting through menus. You can also ask Lazur to explain how to set up an out of office reply or how to delegate access.

faq.question: Is there an official Gmail app for Mac?
faq.answer: No, Google does not produce a native Gmail desktop application for macOS. Users should use a web browser or create a web app via Safari or Chrome.

faq.question: How do I use keyboard shortcuts in Gmail?
faq.answer: You must enable them in Settings > General > Keyboard shortcuts. Once enabled, press ? to view all available commands.

faq.question: What is the daily sending limit for Gmail?
faq.answer: Personal accounts can send to 500 recipients per day, while Google Workspace accounts can send to 2,000 recipients.

faq.question: How can Lazur help me with compliance reports?
faq.answer: You can use Lazur to dictate long reports or policy updates directly into your email drafts using the fn key.

faq.question: Does Lazur click buttons for me?
faq.answer: No, Lazur does not click buttons or operate other apps. It guides you, points at things on your screen, and answers questions out loud.
